explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/100: n points in the plane, pairwise distances at least 1, distinct distances differing by at least 1; is the diameter ≫n? The separate minimum-distance hypothesis is encoded in DistancesSeparated: taking p₁=q₁ gives distance 0, so any nonzero distance is ≥1. Eventual n and strict > are equivalent to ≫n.
